main.description: What the registry is: its DID, which tokens for its methods are addressed to and which a client checks against the origin it reached the registry at; the domain its scopes' handles are under; the scope names it reserves; its limits; whether a new scope waits for the operator's approval; and the registry methods it serves. Public.

scopeApproval.description: Whether a new scope waits for the registry's operator to approve it before its organization can create packages.

methods.description: The registry methods this registry serves, by NSID.

maxBlobSize.description: The largest artifact uploadArtifact stores, in bytes.
